notes.title: Level Update
notes.content: i have been working on the main level adding more detail to the buildings and the surrounding areas

notes.title: Mission Updates
notes.content: New mission system underway with story mode bringing the game to life team up with the police to stop alien crime on the street.

notes.title: Multiplayer Level Update
notes.content: New multiplayer level update includes new tunnel  feature with stairway leading to roof to get the upper hand as you battle through the streets. or fancy a change of scenery entre the club where you can go out side for a element of surprise. You can now smash windows and have a good old bar battle.

notes.title: Alien Street Battle biggest update
notes.content: New updates to alien street battle include bigger open world more room to room new motorbike racing mission race against alien vehicle enter clothes shop try on new clothes for size new tips and tricks teach you all the new game content also added alien character updates bringing aliens to life alien street battle is a on going project built by a single developer and will have a lot more content to come I will be fixing them enjoying bugs and glitches adding new missions smoother gameplay the list never ends thank you to all players of my game and feedback every comment counts

notes.title: Arcade Games
notes.content: i have introduced 3 new arcade games to play in play mode the game is still under construction and will remain updated on a regular basis

notes.title: Finished accessory item pickup
notes.content: you can now pickup and drop all accessory items in multiplayer mode i will now be working on introducing this to play mode and fixing bug issues the game is still under construction and will remain updated on a regular basis

notes.title: New weapons
notes.content: I have added new weapons  and the ability to pick up and drop items in multiplayer mode the game is still under construction and will remain updated on a regular basis

notes.title: New level
notes.content: to all my current players I have added a new level and a level select in play mode the game is still under construction and will remain updated on a regular basis

notes.title: Under construction
notes.content: alien street battle will have a big change around and I will be concentrating on better game play online multi-player and much more alien street battle will be continuously updated on a regular basis

notes.title: Drivable Smashable Cars
notes.content: In this update I have made all cars movable by the player being able to enter and drive the car. The player can also smash the car up earning points with or without character inside.
